The '''Immalia sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Bordered by the [[Fellwe sector/Legends|Fellwe]], the [[Trestis sector/Legends|Trestis]], [[Drannik sector/Legends|Drannik]], and [[Vadigult sector]]s, the Immalia sector had its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Immalia]] in the [[Immalia system/Legends|Immalia system]]. The sector also contained the [[Chalenor system]], with the planet [[Amador]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Mayvitch 7]], the planet [[Meldazar]] in the [[Meldazar system/Legends|Meldazar system]], the astronomical object [[Vorian Four]] in the [[Vorian system/Legends|Vorian system]], and the [[Anduvia system/Legends|Anduvia system]].

==History==
The Immalia sector was first explored between [[8000 BBY]] and [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]], and its average population per planet ranged between less than 1 million to 10 million. The sector was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as early as [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], though it fell within unaligned space during the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Sometime between [[3667 BBY|3667]]<ref name="date">The ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' indicates [[Elin Garza]] forged her identity credentials at the age of 15 to enlist in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], meaning that the minimum age must be greater than 15. The same guide also gives [[Fideltin Rusk]]'s birth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as [[3682 BBY]], meaning that Rusk had to enlist sometime in [[3667 BBY]].</ref>&ndash;[[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Amador was the site of a [[Battle on Amador|battle]],<ref name="Ambient" /> and Mayvitch 7 was attacked by the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the nearby Fellwe sector during the [[Yinchorri Uprising]] of [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="Acts" /> The sector was part of the [[Immalia Oversector]], the theater of operations for the Republic's [[Seventh Army]] under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Marcellin Wessel]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The oversector later became part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under the rule of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] Wessel in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
